description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the 'Source' interface within the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines the 'ImmutableSource' class with its associated builder, methods for JSON (de)serialization, migration logic for reply targets, and internal state management of source configuration including addresses, headers, authorization, acknowledgment, and payload settings.

classes.name: ImmutableSource
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Source interface managing source configuration details such as addresses, authorization, header and payload mappings, and reply target logic.

classes.name: ImmutableSource.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of ImmutableSource with flexible configuration options.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ImmutableSource instance to a JSON object considering schema version and predicate filter.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSource instance from a JSON object, extracting configuration details.

methods.name: migrateReplyTarget
methods.description: Migrates legacy reply target configurations to the current standard, based on connection type support.

methods.name: migrateReplyTargetWithoutHeaders
methods.description: Helper to migrate reply target in absence of headers.

methods.name: migrateReplyTargetWithHeaders
methods.description: Helper to migrate reply target with appropriate header mapping.
